purpose: DatePicker, DateRangePicker and DateTimePicker: a text field people can type dates (and, for DateTimePicker, times) into, plus a calendar, all honouring the locale's order, separators and clock.

props.name: allowInput
props.description: Let people type a date instead of picking one. Default true.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show the clear button. Default true.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the calendar after choosing a date. Default true.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: The time used when a day is picked before any time is set, `HH:mm`. Default `00:00`.

props.name: description
props.description: A hint under the label, linked as the control's description.

props.name: error
props.description: Message shown below the control; also marks the control invalid.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description: Always six week rows, so the popover never changes height. Default true.

props.name: format
props.description:
How the chosen date is displayed. `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions` for the
usual cases, or a function for a shape Intl cannot express. Left out,
the locale's own date format is used - which is the right default far
more often than a hand-written one.
props.note: How a typed string is parsed as well as displayed. Changing it can turn a valid entry into a different day.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 12 shows an AM/PM switch; 24 does not. Defaults to the locale's clock.
props.note: 12 or 24. Changes how a typed time is read as well as shown; defaults to the locale's clock.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Called for every rendered day; return true to block it (weekends, holidays).

props.name: label
props.description: The control's name, shown above it and linked to it.

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP-47 tag deciding month names, field order and the first day of the week.
Defaults to the runtime's locale — pass it explicitly when you render on a
server, so the markup matches what the browser produces.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable day. Later days are shown but cannot be picked.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable day. Earlier days are shown but cannot be picked.
props.note: For DateTimePicker a moment, not a day: earlier days cannot be picked, and on the day itself an earlier time is moved up to it.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: How far the minutes move per arrow press. Default 1; 5 or 15 suit scheduling.
props.note: How far the minute moves per arrow press. Typed minutes are not snapped to it.

props.name: name
props.description: Posts the value as `yyyy-mm-dd` in a hidden input.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months shown side by side. Default 1, or 2 for the range picker.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
The chosen day as a `Date` at local midnight, or `null` once cleared.
Accepts a string or a number in `value`, but always hands back a
`Date`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The calendar opened or closed.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts shown beside the calendar ("Last 7 days").
props.note: Labelled shortcuts such as last quarter. They write the same value the calendar does.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value but blocks typing and picking.

props.name: showNow
props.description: Show the "Now" button beside the time. Default true.

props.name: showSeconds
props.description: A seconds field as well. Default false.

props.name: showToday
props.description: Show the "Today" shortcut in the footer. Default true.

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: Number each week down the left of the calendar. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 = Sunday. Defaults to the locale's first day of the week.

supplied: the calendar is a grid with arrow keys between days, PageUp/PageDown between months, Home and End within a week
the selected and focused days are distinguished for assistive technology, not only by colour
the field accepts typing, so the calendar is never the only way in
Escape closes the calendar and returns focus to the field
DateTimePicker's hour, minute and second are spin buttons: arrow keys step them, PageUp and PageDown move further, and a screen reader announces each by name and value
on a 12-hour clock the AM/PM switch is a labelled button, toggled by click or by the arrow keys
required: a `label`, or `aria-label` when the field is visually unlabelled
a `locale` matching the user's, since 03/04 is two different days in two places
an `hourCycle` only when the clock should differ from the locale's own; by default 2:30 PM and 14:30 follow `locale`

composition.notes: The calendar renders in the top layer. `presets` are shortcuts into the same value, not a separate control.

setValue.summary: Write a value into the field, as though a person had entered it.

focus.summary: Move keyboard focus to the field.

open.summary: Open the field's calendar or option list.

close.summary: Close the field's calendar or option list.

safeMutations.rationale: Calendar chrome is presentation. `min`, `max` and `isDateDisabled` are the rules about which dates are legal, and `format` and `locale` decide how a typed string is read — changing either can reinterpret a date the user already entered. For DateTimePicker, `hourCycle` decides how a typed time is read (2:30 against 14:30), and `defaultTime` is the time a picked day receives — both change values, not looks.
